entry.title: Sonix 0.3.12
entry.summary: A ROMpler with 128 presets and 45 instruments - pianos, keys, guitars, strings, brass, choirs, pads, synths, leads, plucks, bass and bells, from CC0 / CC BY recordings and original renders. Four layers, filter, LFO, chorus, delay, reverb, eleven colorways. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Sto
